cases.expected: Review and change links do not submit an application
One server-rejected field preserves every unrelated value and identifies a remedy
Changing effective reviewed content requires reviewing the new content
An inactive dependent answer is not silently included in the submitted payload
Service/global failure is not assigned to an arbitrary field
Unknown submission retains its ID and input and does not create a fresh duplicate
Repeated confirmation while pending starts only one operation
A local reversible archive restores the intended item without a universal confirmation screen
At the Undo deadline no restore call is made or success claimed
A conflicting revision preserves newer state and does not overwrite it
Accepted compensation remains pending rather than restored
Failed compensation preserves original-effect truth and a supplied next step/reference
Successful compensation describes only its declared scope and residual effects
Lost compensation reply remains unknown and recoverable by the same operation
Repeated Undo while pending does not create another compensation
Offer expiry does not prevent checking an already-started compensation

comparison: Original executable implementation plus deliberate negative controls; not an LLM baseline/candidate efficacy experiment
exploratory_findings: Recorded separately; changes to criteria need an explicit erratum
